title: Hacking Cypher
statementMd:
Polycarpus participates in a competition for hacking into a new secure messenger. He's almost won.

Having carefully studied the interaction protocol, Polycarpus came to the conclusion that the secret key can be obtained if he properly cuts the public key of the application into two parts. The public key is a long integer which may consist of even a million digits!

Polycarpus needs to find such a way to cut the public key into two nonempty parts, that the first (left) part is divisible by $*a*$ as a separate number, and the second (right) part is divisible by $*b*$ as a separate number. Both parts should be positive integers that have no leading zeros. Polycarpus knows values $*a*$ and $*b*$.

Help Polycarpus and find any suitable method to cut the public key.

## Input

The first line of the input contains the public key of the messenger — an integer without leading zeroes, its length is in range from $1$ to $10^{6}$ digits. The second line contains a pair of space-separated positive integers $*a*$, $*b*$ ($1 ≤ *a*, *b* ≤ 10^{8}$).

## Output

In the first line print "`YES`" (without the quotes), if the method satisfying conditions above exists. In this case, next print two lines — the left and right parts after the cut. These two parts, being concatenated, must be exactly identical to the public key. The left part must be divisible by $*a*$, and the right part must be divisible by $*b*$. The two parts must be positive integers having no leading zeros. If there are several answers, print any of them.

If there is no answer, print in a single line "`NO`" (without the quotes).
statementZhMd:
Polycarpus 参加了一场破解新型安全通信软件的比赛。他几乎就要获胜了。

在仔细研究了交互协议后，Polycarpus 得出结论：如果能恰当地将该应用的公钥切分成两部分，就可以获得秘密密钥。公钥是一个很长的整数，甚至可能由一百万位数字组成！

Polycarpus 需要找到一种方法，将公钥切分成两个非空部分，使得第一部分（左半部分）作为一个独立的数字能被 $*a*$ 整除，第二部分（右半部分）作为一个独立的数字能被 $*b*$ 整除。两部分都必须是没有前导零的正整数。Polycarpus 已知 $*a*$ 和 $*b*$ 的值。

请帮助 Polycarpus 找到任意一种合适的切分方法。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含通信软件的公钥——一个不含前导零的整数，其长度范围为 $1$ 至 $10^{6}$ 位。第二行包含一对以空格分隔的正整数 $*a*$、$*b*$（$1 ≤ *a*, *b* ≤ 10^{8}$）。

## 输出格式

如果存在满足上述条件的切分方法，第一行输出 `YES`（不含引号）。接下来输出两行，分别表示切分后的左半部分和右半部分。这两部分拼接后必须与公钥完全相同。左半部分必须能被 $*a*$ 整除，右半部分必须能被 $*b*$ 整除。两部分都必须是没有前导零的正整数。如果有多种答案，输出任意一种即可。

如果不存在满足条件的切分方法，单行输出 `NO`（不含引号）。
